_meta.note: 'bookable: false' means no bookable online inventory on any of several future dates checked, spread over weeks; the route stays listed as a real option with no booking link. A route that sells on any checked date stays bookable. fromLAK is an indicative 'from' fare snapshot in LAK, taken on the verified date, for sanity-checking only; never publish it as a fixed fare.

routes.name: Vientiane to Bangkok
routes.editorialNote: The long-haul option on this border, usually run as an overnight sleeper. Many travellers cover the same ground more cheaply by crossing at Nong Khai and continuing separately on a Thai bus or train.

sources.name: The Man in Seat 61
sources.for: the direct Bangkok–Vientiane (Khamsavath) sleeper train and the Nong Khai split

routes.name: Vientiane to Nong Khai
routes.editorialNote: The busiest hop on this border, and the easiest place to change onto Thailand's onward network, including the overnight sleeper train to Bangkok.

routes.name: Vientiane to Udon Thani
routes.editorialNote: Thailand's Transport Co. (BKS) launched a direct Route No. 2 service on 9 September 2026: an 80-baht, 40-seat second-class coach that calls at Udon Thani International Airport before continuing to Vientiane, one round trip a day. Departs Udon Thani Bus Terminal 1 at 09:00, the airport at 09:30, arriving Vientiane 12:00; returns from Vientiane at 14:00, the airport at 16:30, Udon Thani at 17:00. Not sold online yet; buy at the terminal.

sources.name: Southeast Asia Infrastructure
sources.for: the BKS Route No. 2 bus via Udon Thani Airport

routes.name: Vientiane to Khon Kaen
routes.editorialNote: Passes through Nong Khai on the way to northeastern Thailand's largest city, a common changeover point for onward Isaan destinations.

routes.name: Luang Prabang to Chiang Mai
routes.editorialNote: The long way round by road. Many travellers do only one leg this way and take the Mekong slow boat for the other, rather than the same road twice.

routes.name: Luang Prabang to Chiang Rai
routes.editorialNote: Several hours shorter than the Chiang Mai run, on the same road through Huay Xai.

routes.name: Huay Xai to Chiang Rai
routes.editorialNote: The short final hop for travellers who took the two-day Mekong slow boat down from Luang Prabang.

routes.name: Chiang Khong to Huay Xai
routes.durationText: about 5 minutes across the bridge itself
routes.editorialNote: The bridge shuttle isn't sold online, buy the ticket at the counter after Thai immigration, about 20 baht. Book the onward leg from Huay Xai instead, to Chiang Rai or on to Luang Prabang.

routes.name: Pakse to Ubon Ratchathani
routes.editorialNote: The only Laos–Thailand crossing on this list that is a plain land border rather than a river bridge.

routes.name: Savannakhet to Mukdahan
routes.editorialNote: Not sold online up to 4 November 2026, in either direction. The international bus between Savannakhet and Mukdahan still appears on the operator timetable, with departures from 08:15, so buy the ticket locally rather than online.

routes.name: Thakhek to Nakhon Phanom
routes.editorialNote: The crossing where the Thakhek Loop motorbike route begins on the Lao side.

routes.name: Paksan to Bueng Kan
routes.editorialNote: Served by the cross-border bus that launched on 8 January 2026, 100 baht flat, four departures a day each way. Not sold online yet; buy at Bueng Kan Provincial Bus Terminal or in Pakxan.

sources.name: Nation Thailand
sources.for: the bridge toll plan and the bus exemption

routes.name: Vientiane to Hanoi
routes.editorialNote: An overnight sleeper between the two capitals, the main road link on this border.

routes.name: Vientiane to Vinh
routes.editorialNote: Not sold online up to 4 November 2026, in either direction. A daily sleeper still appears on the published timetable, leaving Vientiane at 06:00 and taking about 14 hours; ask at Vientiane's Southern Bus Terminal (Dong Dok).

routes.name: Vientiane to Hue
routes.editorialNote: Crosses into central Vietnam, with Hue's imperial citadel a short hop onward from the border.

routes.name: Vientiane to Da Nang
routes.editorialNote: The longest of the routes on this crossing, ending on Vietnam's central coast.

routes.name: Savannakhet to Hue
routes.editorialNote: The busiest Laos–Vietnam gate, on the way to Hue's imperial citadel.

routes.name: Savannakhet to Da Nang
routes.editorialNote: The same crossing as the Hue service, continuing further down the coast.

routes.name: Savannakhet to Hanoi
routes.editorialNote: The longest option on this crossing, for the capital rather than the central coast.

routes.name: Pakse to Hue
routes.editorialNote: Direct minivans leave Pakse around 04:00 and cross at La Lay via Salavan. No Lao visa is issued at La Lay, so coming the other way you need one in advance.

sources.name: Laovietbus: Pakse to Hue and Da Nang
sources.for: the La Lay crossing and departure times

routes.name: Pakse to Da Nang
routes.editorialNote: The same early minivans as Pakse to Hue, via La Lay, continuing to the coast.

sources.name: Laovietbus: Pakse to Hue and Da Nang
sources.for: the La Lay crossing and departure times

routes.name: Thakhek to Da Nang
routes.editorialNote: A quieter crossing than the others on this border, close to the Phong Nha caves.

routes.name: Luang Prabang to Hanoi
routes.editorialNote: Runs through Phonsavan to the Nam Kan – Nậm Cắn border; coming the other way, that gate issues no Lao visa on arrival.

sources.name: Laovietbus
sources.for: the direct sleeper route via Xieng Khouang and the Nam Can border

routes.name: Thakhek to Vinh
routes.editorialNote: No bookable service on this pair. The crossing exists, but the bus does not run to a schedule you can reserve ahead. Buy in Thakhek a day or two before, or route via Vientiane.

routes.name: Thakhek to Phong Nha
routes.editorialNote: The Na Phao–Cha Lo crossing is the direct line to Phong Nha, but there is no bookable service. Travellers generally go via Vientiane or Savannakhet instead.

routes.name: Thakhek to Hue
routes.durationText: 10 h to 10 h 15 m, departing 23:30 or 06:00
routes.editorialNote: Two direct services a day, run by HTX Van Tai 277 and Thakhek Travel.

routes.name: Attapeu to Kon Tum / Pleiku
routes.editorialNote: The Phou Keua–Bờ Y crossing is open but carries almost no scheduled passenger transport. Local buses run irregularly; ask in Attapeu.

routes.name: Sam Neua to Hanoi
routes.durationText: 4 h 35 m by air, via Vientiane
routes.editorialNote: No through ticket can be booked online for this pair. The flights themselves do run, all connecting through Vientiane, on Lao Airlines, Lao Skyway, Lanexang Airways or Air Cambodia. Overland, no scheduled bus across the Na Mèo crossing could be found in October 2026; travellers report crossing by motorbike, shared taxi or hitchhiking.

routes.name: Pakse to Siem Reap
routes.editorialNote: The gateway to Angkor Wat, on Laos's only crossing into Cambodia.

routes.name: Pakse to Phnom Penh
routes.editorialNote: The same crossing as the Siem Reap service, continuing south to the Cambodian capital.

routes.name: Pakse to Stung Treng
routes.editorialNote: The short version of this crossing, useful for breaking the longer Siem Reap or Phnom Penh journey.

routes.name: 4000 Islands to Siem Reap
routes.editorialNote: Starts right at the border, shaving hours off the same journey from Pakse.

routes.name: 4000 Islands to Stung Treng
routes.editorialNote: The shortest leg across this border, often paired with an onward bus the same day.

routes.name: 4000 Islands to Phnom Penh
routes.editorialNote: Starts closer to the crossing than the Pakse service, for travellers already based in the islands.

routes.name: Vientiane to Vang Vieng
routes.editorialNote: The gateway to Vang Vieng's karst scenery, and the shortest hop on the Laos–China Railway.

sources.name: Travelfish: how to get to Vang Vieng
sources.for: bus station location and local transfers

routes.name: Vientiane to Luang Prabang
routes.editorialNote: The country's best-connected long-haul run, with an overnight VIP bus alongside the much faster railway.

sources.name: Travelfish: how to get to Luang Prabang

routes.name: Vientiane to Pakse
routes.editorialNote: The overnight route south, ending near Wat Phou's Khmer ruins and the Bolaven Plateau's coffee country.

routes.name: Vientiane to Thakhek
routes.editorialNote: The route into the Thakhek Loop, one of Laos's best-known motorbike circuits.

routes.name: Luang Prabang to Vang Vieng
routes.editorialNote: Links the country's two most-visited towns, with karst scenery continuing most of the way.

sources.name: Travelfish: how to get to Vang Vieng
sources.for: bus station location and local transfers

routes.name: Luang Prabang to Nong Khiaw
routes.editorialNote: The road ends here; the Nam Ou river takes over for the boat trip north to Muang Ngoi.

sources.name: Travelfish: how to get to Nong Khiaw

routes.name: Huay Xai to Luang Prabang
routes.editorialNote: The two-day Mekong slow boat, with a night in Pakbeng. The public boat also sells its tickets at the counter on the Huay Xai pier, and leaves late in the morning.

routes.name: Vientiane to Phonsavan
routes.editorialNote: Lao Airlines flies the same trip in 40 minutes, once or twice a day.

routes.name: Luang Prabang to Phonsavan
routes.editorialNote: Minivans leave early in the morning; there is no direct flight.

routes.name: Paksan to Phonsavan
routes.editorialNote: Not sold online. Coming from Pakse or Thakhek, take the bus towards Vientiane, get off at Pakxan and change to a bus to Xieng Khouang; buy that ticket at the bus station.

routes.name: Muang Khua to Dien Bien Phu
routes.editorialNote: Not sold online. A local bus runs between Muang Khua and Điện Biên Phủ through the Pang Hok–Tây Trang crossing; buy the ticket at the bus station, and expect to agree the fare with the driver if the counter is closed.

stations.name: Vientiane Railway Station (Laos–China Railway)
stations.distanceToTown: about 14–15 km north-east of the centre, at Don Noun, Xaythany district
stations.note: Not an immigration checkpoint: Kunming through-train passengers clear Lao immigration at Boten. Not the same station as Khamsavath, the terminus of the train from Thailand, about 7 km out.
stations.transfer: Shared minivan or taxi; allow 30 minutes or more to the centre, and longer when a train has just emptied. Tickets are also sold in town at Vientiane Center, ground floor.

ja.name: ビエンチャン駅(ラオス中国鉄道)
ja.distanceToTown: 中心部から北東へ約14~15km(サイタニー郡ドンヌン)
ja.transfer: 乗り合いミニバンかタクシーで中心部まで30分以上。列車が着いた直後はさらにかかります。市内のビエンチャン・センター1階でも切符を買えます。

ko.name: 비엔티안역(라오스-중국 철도)
ko.transfer: 합승 미니밴이나 택시로 시내까지 30분 이상 걸리고, 열차가 막 도착한 직후에는 더 걸립니다. 시내 비엔티안 센터 1층에서도 표를 살 수 있습니다.

ru.name: Вокзал Вьентьян (железная дорога Лаос–Китай)
ru.distanceToTown: примерно в 14–15 км к северо-востоку от центра, Дон Нун (район Сайтхани)
ru.transfer: Маршрутный минивэн или такси; до центра не меньше 30 минут, а сразу после прибытия поезда дольше. Билеты продают и в городе, на первом этаже Vientiane Center.

zh.name: 永珍火車站（中寮鐵路）
zh.distanceToTown: 市中心東北方約 14–15 km，位於 Xaythany 區 Don Noun
zh.transfer: 搭共乘小巴或計程車到市區至少留 30 分鐘，火車剛到站時要更久。市區 Vientiane Center 一樓也售票。

stations.name: Vang Vieng Railway Station
stations.transfer: Minivan or green shared bus 40,000 kip, or a tuk tuk; about 10 minutes.

ja.name: バンビエン駅
ja.transfer: ミニバンか緑色の乗り合いバスで4万キップ、またはトゥクトゥクで約10分。

ko.name: 방비엥역
ko.transfer: 미니밴이나 초록색 합승 버스로 4만 킵, 또는 뚝뚝으로 약 10분.

ru.name: Вокзал Ванг Вьенг
ru.distanceToTown: в 3–4 км к северу от города
ru.transfer: Минивэн или зелёный маршрутный автобус за 40 000 кип либо тук-тук, около 10 минут.

zh.name: 萬榮火車站
zh.transfer: 搭小巴或綠色共乘巴士，票價 40,000 kip；也可搭嘟嘟車，車程約 10 分鐘。

stations.name: Luang Prabang Railway Station
stations.distanceToTown: about 11 km from the old town
stations.transfer: Shared minivan about 30 minutes, around 40,000 kip a head; a private taxi costs several times that. Tickets are also sold in the old town, so you do not have to go out to the station twice.

ja.name: ルアンパバーン駅
ja.transfer: 乗り合いミニバンで約30分、1人約4万キップ。貸切タクシーはその数倍です。旧市街でも切符を買えるので、駅まで2度行く必要はありません。

ko.name: 루앙프라방역
ko.transfer: 합승 미니밴으로 약 30분, 1인당 약 4만 킵이며 전세 택시는 그 몇 배입니다. 구시가지에서도 표를 팔기 때문에 역에 두 번 갈 필요가 없습니다.

ru.name: Вокзал Луанг Прабанг
ru.transfer: Маршрутный минивэн около 30 минут, примерно 40 000 кип с человека; такси в несколько раз дороже. Билеты продают и в старом городе, так что ехать на вокзал дважды не нужно.

zh.name: 龍坡邦火車站
zh.transfer: 共乘小巴約 30 分鐘，每人約 40,000 kip；包車計程車價格高出數倍。舊城區也售票，不必為買票往返車站兩次。

stations.name: Boten Railway Station
stations.distanceToTown: about 4 km from the road border

ja.name: ボーテン駅
ja.transfer: 乗り合いタクシーで6万キップまたは20元。

ru.name: Вокзал Ботэн
ru.distanceToTown: около 4 км от автомобильного пограничного перехода
ru.transfer: Маршрутное такси за 60 000 кип или 20 юаней.

zh.name: 磨丁火車站
zh.transfer: 共乘計程車 60,000 kip 或 20 RMB。
